title: Français 4687 — ff5v–7v
contents: Italian family correspondence mentioning Milan, a stable master, Carlo, a brother, and an offer of scudi for a state. The letter remains partly unread.
status: 4/4 pages transcribed in part; 2/4 pages deciphered in part
fields: Marguerite Paléologue (catalogue attribution for ff1 onward)
Louis de Gonzague, duke of Nevers (catalogue attribution)
17 numerical code classes; some written forms remain uncertain.
f5v/f6r: 241 elements transcribed and deciphered. f6v/f7v: 356 base signs transcribed, none deciphered; code groups unresolved.

excerpt: **Averia dat volontier a cuatr cento mila scudi per aver cuel stato et pareva ? ascoltase ? parla**
translation: [He] would willingly have given four hundred thousand scudi to obtain that state, and it seemed ? would listen ? speaks.
